title: Public salience mobilizes nationwide responses to violence against women
abstract: arXiv:2611.02647v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Does public salience around femicides mobilize societal responses or trigger further harm through imitation? Using newly assembled case-level data on femicides in Italy from 2017 to 2024, we study the nationwide consequences of the most salient cases for help-seeking, police reporting, and lethal violence. We find that highly salient intimate partner femicides (IPFs) generate nationwide increases in help-seeking, and that an exceptionally salient IPF also leads to a marked rise in police reports of violence against women. Yet we find no evidence of an increase in femicides-a pattern inconsistent with copycat theories. Responses are strongest during periods of peak salience. No comparable mobilization follows a lower-salience IPF, a similarly salient femicide committed by family members, a highly salient killing of a woman not classified as a femicide, or a lower-salience falsification case. translated_title: 公共显著性激发全国范围内对针对女性暴力事件的响应
translated_abstract: 围绕杀害女性事件的公共显著性究竟是能动员社会响应，还是会通过模仿效应引发更多伤害？利用新整理的2017至2024年意大利杀害女性案件的个案层面数据，我们研究了最具显著性案件对求助行为、警方报案和致命暴力的全国性影响。我们发现，高显著性的伴侣间杀害女性案件（IPF）会引发全国范围内求助行为的增加，而一起格外显著的伴侣间杀害女性案件还导致针对女性暴力的警方报案明显上升。然而，我们没有发现杀害女性事件增加的证据——这一模式与模仿理论不相符。社会响应在公共显著性达到顶峰的时期最为强烈。较低显著性的伴侣间杀害女性案件、家人实施的类似显著性的杀害女性案件、未被归类为杀害女性的高显著性杀害女性案件，或较低显著性的伪造案件，均未引发类似的动员。这些比较共同表明，这种动员……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本研究利用意大利2017-2024年的案件数据发现，高显著性的伴侣杀害女性案件会引发全国范围内求助和警方报案的显著增加，但未出现模仿性杀害，表明公众关注能动员社会保护性响应而非触发模仿犯罪。
en_tdlr: Using case-level data from Italy (2017-2024), this study shows that highly salient intimate partner femicides mobilize nationwide increases in help-seeking and police reporting without any evidence of copycat killings, indicating that public salience triggers protective societal responses rather than imitation.
